directions.name: Coding Agents
directions.exclude: Terminal access alone does not establish coding: general system administration belongs to task-appropriate computer/enterprise collections. Static function generation remains in Library.
directions.description: Agents that modify repositories, fix software and complete developer workflows.

directions.name: Computer Use
directions.exclude: Generation of interface code is not computer operation. Grounding remains a detailed subtopic.
directions.description: Operating web, desktop and mobile interfaces, including visual grounding.

directions.name: Deep Research & Web Search
directions.exclude: Fixed-context QA and static retrieval alone stay in detailed Library labels.
directions.description: Finding sources, gathering evidence and answering research questions on the web.

directions.name: Tool Use
directions.exclude: Using a tool incidentally does not assign this topic; tool use must be an evaluated objective.
directions.description: Selecting and calling tools, functions and APIs.

directions.name: Agent Memory
directions.exclude: Long input length alone is not agent memory.
directions.description: Retaining and using information across interactions and sessions.

directions.name: Multi-Agent Systems
directions.exclude: A multi-agent solver baseline does not make a coordination benchmark.
directions.description: Coordination, communication and collaboration between agents.

directions.name: Personal & Enterprise Agents
directions.exclude: Domain labels such as finance/legal remain detailed facets; avoid generic miscellaneous work.
directions.description: Completing personal, workplace and enterprise workflows.

directions.name: Data Analysis Agents
directions.exclude: Generic tabular prediction or passive data QA without agent execution stays in Library.
directions.description: Analyzing data with code, databases, notebooks and spreadsheets.

directions.name: AI Research Agents
directions.exclude: Improving a target model is distinct from improving the agent itself.
directions.description: Designing and running machine-learning research and engineering experiments.

directions.name: Self-Improving Agents
directions.exclude: RSI is a stricter subtag; ordinary post-training or within-task retries are not enough.
directions.description: Agents that improve their own behavior using retained experience or feedback.

directions.name: Agent Harnesses & Skills
directions.exclude: Using a harness to run a benchmark is not sufficient. Require a scored harness/skill objective.
directions.reviewFrom: new topic; selected self-improvement and coding records
directions.description: Building agent systems, execution scaffolds and reusable skills.

directions.name: Agent Safety & Security
directions.exclude: Separate attack/defense/security operations through detailed facets; generic toxicity QA is not agent evaluation.
directions.description: Agent permissions, prompt injection, privacy, misuse and safe execution.

directions.name: AI for Science
directions.exclude: Science exam questions are not scientific agent workflows; ML-method development belongs to AI Research Agents.
directions.description: Agents that conduct scientific investigations, discover equations or perform research workflows.

directions.name: OCR & Document Understanding
directions.exclude: Do not attribute whole OCR toolkit popularity exclusively to its embedded benchmark.
directions.description: Reading text, parsing documents and understanding charts and tables.

directions.name: Video Understanding
directions.exclude: Dated documents/images do not establish video evaluation.
directions.description: Understanding events, actions and temporal relationships in video.

directions.name: Speech & Audio
directions.exclude: Offline audio/video QA alone does not establish real-time interaction.
directions.description: Recognizing, understanding and generating speech and audio.

directions.name: World Models
directions.exclude: Do not include every paper using the phrase world model; ML execution surrogates require task-specific review.
directions.description: Predicting physical environments and their evolution under actions.

directions.name: Embodied AI & VLA
directions.exclude: Static 3D reasoning and non-language RL remain distinguished in detailed metadata.
directions.description: Perception, reasoning and control for embodied agents and robots.

directions.name: Image & Video Generation
directions.exclude: Not automatically world modeling or an agent evaluation.
directions.description: Generating and editing images and videos.

directions.name: Efficient Inference
directions.exclude: A fast model release or an implementation repository is not automatically a benchmark; ordinary post-training remains a detailed Library topic.
directions.description: Reducing inference cost, memory use and latency.
